blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification requires representations that jointly capture local waveform morphology, long-range temporal dynamics, and cross-lead dependencies, yet integrating these properties within a single efficient architecture remains challenging. This paper introduces a hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification. A convolutional stem performs early waveform tokenization and temporal reduction, mixed state-space and depthwise convolutional blocks model temporal dynamics and local morphology, and a late self-attention stage enables global token interaction at reduced resolution. To improve transfer from unlabeled data, we further develop an ECG-oriented Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining (JEPA) framework. Unlike ViT-based JEPA methods that mask patch tokens before the encoder, the proposed method samples span masks at the latent temporal resolution and projects them back to the waveform domain, then predicts clean latent targets from a momentum encoder without waveform reconstruction. Experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL, with pretraining on approximately 350K unlabeled CODE-15 recordings, show that the proposed backbone provides strong supervised baselines under a compact parameter budget. JEPA pretraining further improves transfer, particularly in reduced-label settings and under both full fine-tuning and LoRA-based adaptation. Code: https://github.com/yakoubbazi/Hybrid_ECG_Jepa .
blocks.zh: 自动十二铅心电图(ECG)分类需要能联合捕捉局部波形形态,长距离时间动态,以及跨铅依赖的表示,然而将这些特性整合在一个单一高效的架构中仍然具有挑战性. 本文引入了混合式CNN-SSM-Attention主干线,用于12头ECG分类. 演化干能进行早期的波形示意和时间缩短,混合的状态空间和深度的演化区块模拟时间动力学和局部形态学,而后期的自觉阶段能使全球的符号相互作用在降低分辨率. 为了改进无标签数据的传输,我们进一步发展了面向ECG的联合预测培训(JEPA)框架。 与基于ViT的JEPA方法在编码器前遮盖补丁符号不同,拟议的方法样本在潜在时间分辨率上遮盖并投射回波形域,然后在没有波形重建的情况下从动力编码器中预测干净的潜在目标. 关于CPSC2018、Chapman-Shaoxing和PTB-XL的实验,对大约350K无标签的CODE-15录音进行预先培训,显示拟议的主干线在紧凑的参数预算下提供了强有力的监督基线。 联合环保局的预训进一步改善了转让,特别是在减标签环境下以及在全面微调和基于LORA的适应下。 代码:https://github.com/yakoubbazi/Hybrid_ECG_Jepa 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-20. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is one of the most widely used non-invasive tools for cardiac assessment. A standard 12-lead ECG records cardiac electrical activity from complementary anatomical views, making it possible to assess rhythm disorders, conduction abnormalities, ischemic changes, and morphological deviations. Automated 12-lead ECG interpretation, however, remains challenging because clinically relevant patterns appear at multiple temporal and spatial scales. Some diagnostic cues are highly local, such as QRS morphology and ST–T changes, whereas others depend on longer temporal context and consistency across leads [ 24 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 电心学(ECG)是用于心脏评估的最广泛使用的非侵入性工具之一. 一个标准的12铅ECG记录了来自互补解剖观点的心电活动,从而有可能评估节奏失调,传导异常,异化变化,以及形态偏差. 然而,由于临床相关模式出现在多个时间和空间尺度上,自动十二铅ECG解释仍然具有挑战性。 一些诊断提示是高度局部性的,例如QRS形态学和ST-T变化,而另一些则依赖于较长的时间背景和跨线索的一致性[24,19].

blocks.en: Deep learning has substantially advanced automated ECG classification, but designing an effective backbone for 12-lead signals remains non-trivial. Convolutional neural networks provide strong local inductive biases for waveform morphology and remain competitive ECG baselines. Transformers, on the other hand, enable explicit global interaction among temporal tokens, but their quadratic complexity can be inefficient for long ECG sequences. More recently, selective state-space models (SSMs), including Mamba-style architectures, have provided an efficient alternative for long-context sequence modeling with linear-time complexity [ 5 ] . These developments suggest that local morphology extraction, efficient temporal sequence modeling, and global token interaction are complementary rather than mutually exclusive. Nevertheless, scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention designs remain underexplored for 12-lead ECG classification.
blocks.zh: 深层学习已经大大推进了ECG的自动化分类,但为12条线索信号设计有效的主干线仍然是非三角的. 演化神经网络为波形形态提供了强烈的局部诱导偏差,并且仍然是具有竞争力的ECG基线. 另一方面,变形器可以使时间符号之间有明确的全球互动,但其四维复杂性对于长时间的ECG序列来说可能效率低下. 最近,选择性的状态空间模型(SSM),包括曼巴式的架构,为具有线性时间复杂度的长文本序列模型提供了高效的替代品[5]. 这些发展动态表明,局部形态提取、有效的时间序列建模以及全球象征性互动是相辅相成的,而不是相互排斥的。 尽管如此,可扩展的CNN-SSM-Attention混合设计对于12头ECG分类仍然没有得到充分利用.

blocks.en: A second challenge is the dependence on labeled ECG data. Large collections of raw ECG recordings are increasingly available, but expert annotations remain costly, time-consuming, and often dataset-specific. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has therefore become an important direction for ECG representation learning. Existing methods include contrastive learning, cross-view objectives, masked reconstruction, and large-scale ECG foundation models [ 11 , 18 , 7 , 21 , 22 , 16 , 17 ] . Among these directions, joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) are attractive because they avoid direct raw-signal reconstruction and instead learn by predicting latent targets from corrupted inputs. Recent ECG studies indicate that JEPA-style pretraining can learn transferable representations for downstream classification [ 10 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 第二个挑战是对标注ECG数据的依赖. 大量原始ECG录音的收集越来越多,但专家说明仍然昂贵、耗时,而且往往是针对数据集的。 因此,自我监督的学习(SSL)已成为ECG代表学习的重要方向. 现有方法包括对比性学习,跨视角目标,蒙面重建,以及大规模ECG基础模型[11,18,7,21,22,16,17]. 在这些方向中,联合嵌入式预测建筑(JEPA)具有吸引力,因为它们避免了直接的原始信号重建,而是通过预测腐败投入的潜在目标来学习。 最近的ECG研究表明,JEPA式的预训可以学习下游分类的可转移表述[10,25].

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification. The architecture follows a staged design. A convolutional stem first extracts local waveform morphology and performs early temporal reduction. The intermediate stages use mixed sequence-morphology blocks that combine selective state-space mixing with lightweight depth-wise convolutional processing, allowing the model to capture long-range temporal dependencies while preserving local waveform structure. A final self-attention stage is then applied after temporal compression, enabling explicit global token interaction at a reduced computational cost. This design assigns each modeling mechanism to a suitable part of the network hierarchy: convolution for early local structure, SSM-based mixing for efficient temporal modeling, and attention for high-level global integration.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个可扩展的CNN-SSM-专注混合主干线,用于12头ECG分类. 建筑采用分阶段设计. 演化干首先提取出局部波形形态,并进行早期的时间还原. 中间阶段采用混合序列-形态区块,结合选择性的状态-空间混合与轻量级深度-智旋式处理,使模型在保留局部波形结构的同时能够捕捉长距离的时间依赖性. 然后在时间压缩后适用最后的自我注意阶段,从而能够以较低的计算成本进行明确的全球符号交互。 这种设计将每个建模机制分配到网络层级的合适部分:为早期局部结构的演化,基于SSM的混合,以高效的时间建模,以及关注高层次的全球一体化.

blocks.en: We further study JEPA-style self-supervised pretraining for the proposed backbone. Unlike ViT-based JEPA formulations, where masking is applied directly to patch tokens before the encoder, our method uses latent-aligned waveform corruption. Specifically, temporal masks are sampled at the latent temporal resolution of the backbone, which is reduced by a factor of four relative to the input waveform. The sampled mask is then expanded back to the raw waveform domain, where the selected ECG regions are replaced by learned lead-wise masking values with small additive noise. The online encoder processes this corrupted ECG, while a momentum target encoder processes the clean signal and provides latent prediction targets. Thus, the method performs masked latent prediction without reconstructing the raw ECG waveform and without inserting explicit ViT-style mask tokens into the encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步研究JEPA式的自我监督预训,为拟议的骨干. 与基于ViT的JEPA配方不同,在编码器前直接将遮掩应用到补丁符号上,我们的方法使用潜在的对齐波形腐败. 具体地说,时间口罩在骨干的潜在时间分辨率下进行取样,相对于输入波形,时间口罩的分量减少4倍. 采样的面具随后被扩展回原始的波形域,其中选定的ECG区域被学习到的铅性遮罩值用小的添加噪音取代. 在线编码器处理这个腐烂的ECG,而动力目标编码器处理干净的信号并提供潜在的预测目标. 因此,该方法不重建原始的ECG波形,也不在编码器中插入明显的ViT式的面具符号,而进行蒙面潜伏的预测.

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed framework on three public 12-lead ECG benchmarks: CPSC2018, Chapman, and PTB-XL. The experiments include supervised training from random initialization, full fine-tuning from self-supervised initialization, LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation, and reduced-label transfer settings. This evaluation is intended to assess both the intrinsic capacity of the proposed backbone and the transfer behavior induced by JEPA-style pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个12个公共牵头ECG基准评价拟议框架:CPSC-2018、Chapman和PTB-XL。 实验包括从随机初始化开始的受监督训练,从自我监督初始化开始的完全微调,基于LORA的参数高效适应,以及减标签传输设置. 本评价旨在评估拟议骨干内在能力和JEPA式预训引发的转移行为。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: 1. We propose a scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification, integrating convolutional morphology extraction, efficient state-space sequence modeling, and late self-attention within a unified architecture. 2. We introduce an ECG-specific JEPA pretraining strategy with latent-aligned waveform corruption, where masks are sampled at latent resolution and applied in the waveform domain for masked latent prediction. 3. We conduct comprehensive experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman, and PTB-XL, covering supervised training from scratch, full fine-tuning, LoRA-based adaptation, and reduced-label transfer.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们提出一个可扩展的混合式CNN-SSM-用于12铅ECG分类的专注主干线,将演化形态提取,高效的状态空间序列建模,以及迟到的自我注意纳入一个统一的架构中。 2. 我们采用了针对欧洲集团的《联合环境保护法》预训战略,其中涉及潜在波形腐败,对口罩进行潜在分辨率取样,并在波形领域用于掩盖的潜在预测。 3. 我们对CPSC2018、Chapman和PTB-XL进行全面试验,包括从头到尾监督培训、全面微调、基于LORA的适应和减标签转让。

blocks.en: We propose a scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone for 12-lead ECG classification, integrating convolutional morphology extraction, efficient state-space sequence modeling, and late self-attention within a unified architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个可扩展的混合式CNN — — SSM — — ECG 分类的主干线,将演化形态提取,高效的状态空间序列模型化,以及迟到的自我意识整合到一个统一的架构中。

blocks.en: We introduce an ECG-specific JEPA pretraining strategy with latent-aligned waveform corruption, where masks are sampled at latent resolution and applied in the waveform domain for masked latent prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了针对欧洲集团的JEPA预训战略,其中包含潜在的对齐波形腐败,其中口罩以潜在分辨率取样,并应用于波形领域,用于掩盖的潜在预测。

blocks.en: We conduct comprehensive experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman, and PTB-XL, covering supervised training from scratch, full fine-tuning, LoRA-based adaptation, and reduced-label transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们在CPSC2018、Chapman和PTB-XL上进行了全面的实验,包括从头到尾的监管培训、全面微调、基于LORA的适应和减标签转移。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work on ECG backbones, state-space sequence modeling, and self-supervised ECG representation learning. Section 3 presents the proposed hybrid ECG backbone. Section 4 describes the JEPA-style self-supervised pretraining framework. Section 5 reports the experimental setup and results. Section 6 concludes the paper.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews prior work related to the proposed framework. We focus on two directions: backbone design for 12-lead ECG classification and self-supervised ECG representation learning.
blocks.zh: 本节审查以前与拟议框架有关的工作。 我们侧重于两个方向:12个领导ECG分类的主干设计和自我监督的ECG代表学习.

blocks.en: 2.1 Backbones for 12-Lead ECG Classification
blocks.zh: 2.1 12 铅ECG的背骨 分类

blocks.en: Deep learning has become a dominant paradigm for automated 12-lead ECG classification. Early and widely used methods are largely based on one-dimensional convolutional neural networks, which are well matched to the local structure of ECG waveforms. Many diagnostic patterns, including QRS morphology, ST–T abnormalities, and beat-level deformation, are expressed through localized temporal changes. As a result, convolutional models remain strong baselines on public ECG benchmarks such as PTB-XL and CPSC2018 [ 24 , 19 ] . However, ECG interpretation also requires broader temporal reasoning and cross-lead integration, since rhythm abnormalities, conduction patterns, and multilead morphological consistency may depend on information distributed across time and leads.
blocks.zh: 深入学习已成为自动12铅ECG分类的主要范例。 早期和广泛使用的方法主要基于单维的演化神经网络,这些神经网络与ECG波形的局部结构非常吻合. 许多诊断模式,包括QRS形态,ST-T异常,以及节拍水平变形,都通过局部时间变化来表达. 因此,演化模型仍然是公共ECG基准的强基线,如PTB-XL和CPSC2018[24,19]. 然而,ECG解释还需要更广泛的时间推理和跨铅结合,因为节奏异常,导电规律,多铅形态一致性可能取决于跨时间和线索分布的信息.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, recent studies have moved toward hybrid architectures that combine local waveform processing with mechanisms for longer-range or multiscale interaction. DAMS-Net introduces dual attention and multiscale feature fusion to capture complementary local and global representations [ 28 ] . MSGFormer and MCTNet further explore transformer-style and multiscale token interaction for 12-lead ECG analysis [ 8 , 12 ] . Other convolution-attention hybrids similarly combine front-end morphology extraction with attention-based aggregation or temporal reasoning modules [ 3 , 26 ] . These methods suggest that effective ECG backbones should not rely on a single modeling principle, but should instead combine local, temporal, and global representations in a structured manner.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一局限性,最近的研究已经转向混合结构,将局部波形处理与较长期或多尺度互动机制相结合。 DAMS-Net引入了双重关注和多规模的特征组合,以获取互补的地方和全球代表[28]. MSGFormer和MCTNet进一步探索变压器风格和多比例符号交互,用于12个主ECG分析[8,12]. 其他的演化-意向混合体类似地将前端形态学提取与基于注意力的集合或时间推理模块[3,26]结合. 这些方法表明,有效的ECG主干网不应依赖单一的建模原则,而应以结构化的方式将地方、时间和全球代表性结合起来。

blocks.en: State-space models (SSMs) have recently emerged as an efficient alternative for long-sequence modeling. In a standard discrete formulation, an SSM updates a latent state according to 𝐬 t + 1 = 𝐀𝐬 t + 𝐁𝐱 t , 𝐲 t = 𝐂𝐬 t + 𝐃𝐱 t , \mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\mathbf{A}\mathbf{s}_{t}+\mathbf{B}\mathbf{x}_{t},\qquad\mathbf{y}_{t}=\mathbf{C}\mathbf{s}_{t}+\mathbf{D}\mathbf{x}_{t}, (1) where 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} is the input at time step t t , 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} is the latent state, and 𝐲 t \mathbf{y}_{t} is the output. Selective SSMs, particularly Mamba, make the state update input-dependent and provide linear-time sequence modeling, making them attractive for long ECG recordings [ 5 ] . This efficiency is important because clinically relevant ECG dependencies may span multiple beats, while full self-attention can be computationally expensive when applied at high temporal resolution.
blocks.zh: 国家空间模型(SSMs)最近已成为长序模型的有效替代。 在标准离散配方中,一个SSM根据 t + 1 = as t + Bx t, y t = Cs + Dx t,\ mathbf{s}_{t+1}=\ mathbf{A}\mathbf{s}_{t}+\mathbf{B}\mathbf{x}_{t},\qquad\mathb{y}_{t}=\mathb{f{C}\mathb{f{t{h{h{h{f{x}_{t}更新潜态, (1) x t\ mathbf{x}_{t} 是时间步 t t 的输入, s t\ mathbf{s}_{t} 是潜在状态, y t\ mathbf{y}_{t} 是输出状态 。 选择性的SSM,尤其是曼巴,使状态更新的输入依赖,并提供线性时间序列模型,使其对长篇ECG录音[5]具有吸引力. 这种效率很重要,因为临床上相关的ECG依赖性可能跨越多个节拍,而完全的自觉性在高时间分辨率下应用时则可以计算成本.

blocks.en: Several recent works have adapted Mamba-style architectures to ECG analysis. ECGMamba uses bidirectional Mamba blocks with residual and feed-forward refinement for ECG classification [ 20 ] . ECG-Mamba follows a related direction by building a 12-lead classifier around a bidirectional SSM backbone and task-specific augmentation [ 9 ] . In these approaches, Mamba typically acts as the main temporal modeling component or as a substitute for transformer-style sequence processing.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些作品对曼巴式建筑进行了改造,以适应ECG分析. ECGMamba采用双向Mamba区块,对ECG分类进行残留和饲料改进[20]. ECG-Mamba遵循相关方向,围绕双向SSM主干线和任务特异性增强搭建了12个主分类器[9]. 在这些方法中,曼巴一般充当主要的时间模型组件或替代变压器式的序列处理.

blocks.en: Different from these works, our goal is not to replace attention with SSMs or to use Mamba as a standalone ECG backbone. Instead, we design a staged hybrid architecture motivated by a distinct modeling consideration. The convolutional stem performs early morphology extraction and temporal reduction. The intermediate stages combine selective state-space mixing with depth-wise convolutional processing to jointly model long-range temporal structure and local waveform patterns. The final stage applies self-attention only after temporal compression, enabling explicit global token interaction with reduced computational cost. This design provides a unified CNN–SSM–Attention hierarchy tailored to 12-lead ECG signals.
blocks.zh: 与这些作品不同,我们的目标不是用SSM代替注意力,也不是将曼巴作为独立的ECG骨干. 相反,我们设计了一个分阶段混合结构,其动机是不同的建模考虑。 旋茎进行早期形态提取和时间缩短. 中间阶段将选择性的状态-空间混合与深智的演化处理结合起来,共同模拟长距离时间结构和局部波形模式. 最后阶段只在时间压缩后适用自我注意,从而能够与降低的计算成本进行明确的全球符号互动。 这种设计提供了针对12个领先ECG信号的统一的CNN-SSM-Attention等级.

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-Supervised ECG Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 自我监督的ECG 代表学习

blocks.en: A major challenge in ECG learning is the limited availability of high-quality diagnostic labels, which has motivated a broad range of SSL methods. Early ECG SSL approaches were dominated by contrastive learning. Representative examples include CLOCS, which constructs contrastive objectives across temporal, spatial, and patient-level views [ 11 ] , and later multilead ECG SSL methods that exploit ECG-specific augmentations or cross-view consistency [ 18 , 7 , 21 , 13 , 15 , 14 ] . A parallel line of work explores masked reconstruction or masked autoencoding, where the model reconstructs either raw waveforms or latent features from corrupted inputs [ 22 , 17 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh: ECG学习中的一个主要挑战是高质量诊断标签的提供有限,这激发了广泛的SSL方法. 早期ECG SSL方法以对比性学习为主. 代表性的例子包括CLOCS,它构建了跨时间、空间和病人层面的对比目标[11],以及后来利用ECG特定增强或交叉视角一致性的多头ECG SSL方法[18、7、21、13、15、14]。 平行的工作线探索蒙面重建或蒙面自动编码,模型在那里重建原始波形或从腐化的输入物中潜伏的特征[22,17,23].

blocks.en: More recently, JEPA-style latent predictive learning has emerged as an alternative to both contrastive learning and raw-signal reconstruction. Instead of enforcing invariance across augmented views or reconstructing waveform samples directly, JEPA predicts target representations in latent space using a momentum target encoder [ 2 ] . This formulation is particularly appealing for ECG because the downstream objective is not faithful recovery of every low-level fluctuation, but the learning of transferable latent structure that captures waveform morphology, rhythm patterns, and inter-lead relationships.
blocks.zh: 最近,JEPA式的潜在预测性学习已经出现,作为对比性学习和原始信号重建的替代办法。 JEPA不是直接在增强的视野中强制执行变化或重建波形样本,而是利用动力目标编码器预测潜在空间中的目标表示[2]。 这种提法对ECG特别有吸引力,因为下游的目标不是忠实地恢复每一个低水平的波动,而是学习能够捕捉波形形态、节奏规律和铅间关系的可转移潜在结构。

blocks.en: Recent ECG studies have started to explore this direction explicitly. ECG-JEPA adapts JEPA to 12-lead ECGs using masked latent prediction and a transformer-based encoder, and further introduces a cross-pattern attention design tailored to multilead ECG structure [ 10 ] . In another work, the authors also study JEPA-based self-supervised pretraining for ECG classification and report that latent predictive learning can outperform both invariance-based and generative pretraining strategies on PTB-XL benchmarks [ 25 ] . These results indicate that JEPA is a promising self-supervised paradigm for ECG representation learning.
blocks.zh: 最近的ECG研究已经开始明确探索这一方向. ECG-JEPA利用隐蔽潜在预测和基于变压器的编码器使JEPA适应12铅ECG,并进一步引入了适合多铅ECG结构的跨式关注设计[10]. 在另一部作品中,作者还研究了基于JEPA的自我监督的ECG分类预训,并报告说,潜在的预测性学习可以超越基于偏差的和基于基因的关于PTB-XL基准的预训战略[25]。 这些结果表明,联合环保局是欧洲教育团体代表性学习的一个有希望的自我监督范例。

blocks.en: Our pretraining strategy follows this JEPA direction but is paired with a different backbone design. Unlike prior ECG-JEPA work built primarily on transformer-style encoders, the present work couples JEPA with the proposed hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone. Pretraining is based on masked latent prediction with a momentum target encoder and ECG-specific structured corruption, without waveform reconstruction or contrastive pairing. In this way, JEPA serves as a representation-learning strategy that complements the proposed backbone rather than defining the main architectural contribution.
blocks.zh: 我们的预训策略遵循JEPA的方向,但与不同的骨干设计搭配. 与之前的ECG-JEPA工作主要建立在变压器风格的编码器上不同,目前的工作伴侣JEPA与拟议的混合CNN-SSM-Atention主干线不同. 预训基于带有动力目标编码器和ECG特定结构化腐败的蒙面潜在预测,没有波形重建或对比配对. 通过这种方式,联合环保局作为代表学习战略,补充了拟议的主干,而不是界定主要的建筑贡献。

blocks.en: 2.3 Relation to the proposed method
blocks.zh: 2.3 与拟议方法的关系

blocks.en: The above literature suggests two main trends. First, 12-lead ECG backbones increasingly benefit from combining local waveform modeling with mechanisms that capture broader temporal and inter-lead context. Second, self-supervised ECG learning is moving from generic contrastive objectives toward masked and latent predictive formulations that better match the structure of multilead signals.
blocks.zh: 上述文献提出了两大趋势。 首先,12个牵头的ECG主干网越来越多地受益于将地方波形模型与抓住更广泛的时间和牵头背景的机制相结合。 第二,自我监督的ECG学习正在从一般对比目标转向更符合多铅信号结构的蒙蔽和潜在预测配方。

blocks.en: The proposed method combines these two directions in a unified framework. Its main contribution is a scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention backbone in which convolution, state-space mixing, and self-attention are assigned distinct roles across the network hierarchy. JEPA-style pretraining is then used as a complementary self-supervised strategy for learning transferable latent representations on top of this backbone. In this sense, the proposed method lies at the intersection of recent hybrid ECG backbone design, emerging SSM-based ECG sequence modeling, and latent predictive SSL for multilead ECGs.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法将这两个方向合并为一个统一的框架。 它的主要贡献是可伸缩的CNN-SSM-Attention骨干,在这种骨干中,演化,状态-空间混合,和自觉被分配到整个网络层级的不同角色. 然后,JEPA式的预训被用作补充性的自我监督战略,在这种主干之上学习可转移的潜在表述。 从这个意义上讲,拟议方法位于最近混合ECG主干设计、新出现的基于SSM的ECG序列模型和多铅ECG的潜在预测SSL的交叉点。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Scalable Hybrid ECG Backbone
blocks.zh: 3 拟议可伸缩混合ECG背骨

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: We propose a scalable hybrid backbone for 12-lead ECG classification. The backbone is organized as a three-stage hierarchy that progressively transforms the raw multi-lead signal into a compact token representation. The overall design is guided by a simple idea: local waveform morphology should be captured early, longer temporal dependencies should be modeled efficiently as the sequence becomes shorter, and self-attention should be introduced only in the final stage, where global interaction is more affordable.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stage 1: Hybrid mixer-based sequence modeling
blocks.zh: 3.3 阶段1:混合搅拌机测序模型

blocks.en: Stage 1 takes the stem output 𝐇 1 \mathbf{H}_{1} as input and applies N 1 N_{1} repeated blocks, each consisting of a hybrid mixer followed by an MLP. As shown in Fig. 2 , the hybrid mixer combines an SSM branch for temporal sequence modeling with a local gated depthwise-convolution branch for morphology-aware refinement. The rationale is to couple efficient long-range temporal mixing with explicit local waveform modeling within the same block. In particular, the SSM branch captures broader temporal dependencies, while the local branch is intended to preserve short-range morphological structure. This design is inspired by the MambaVision mixer proposed for visual backbones [ 6 ] , where a non-SSM convolutional path is introduced to complement the sequential branch and enrich the resulting representation, but is adapted here to 1-D multi-lead ECG signals. After fusion of the two branches, an MLP further refines the representation.

blocks.zh: 3.4 阶段 2: 以混合搅拌器为基础的序列模型,以降低分辨率

The resulting sequence is then processed by the same hybrid mixer-based blocks used in Stage 1. Accordingly, Stage 2 retains the same combination of SSM-based temporal mixing and local gated depthwise-convolutional refinement, but applies it to a shorter and higher-dimensional representation. This allows the model to capture longer-range temporal structure more efficiently while preserving sensitivity to local waveform morphology. Repeating these blocks yields the Stage 2 output, denoted by 𝐙 2 ∈ ℝ T 2 × C 2 \mathbf{Z}_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{2}\times C_{2}} .

blocks.en: 3.5 Stage 3: Global sequence modeling with self-attention
blocks.zh: 3.5 第3阶段:自觉的全球序列模型

blocks.en: Stage 3 begins with a convolutional transition applied to the Stage 2 output 𝐙 2 \mathbf{Z}_{2} , which projects the representation to a higher-dimensional space while preserving the temporal resolution: 𝐇 3 = Conv1D ⁡ ( 𝐙 2 ) ∈ ℝ T 3 × C 3 , \mathbf{H}_{3}=\mathrm{Conv1D}(\mathbf{Z}_{2})\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{3}\times C_{3}}, (12) where the convolution uses kernel size 5 5 , stride 1 1 , and padding 2 2 , yielding T 3 = T 2 T_{3}=T_{2} , while C 3 C_{3} denotes the expanded feature dimension. Since the temporal resolution has already been reduced before Stage 3, no further downsampling is applied at this point; instead, the transition preserves the compressed token sequence while projecting it to a higher-dimensional space prior to global self-attention. Unlike the preceding stages, Stage 3 adopts a pure Transformer-style design composed of repeated self-attention and MLP blocks, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . Operating at the reduced temporal resolution makes self-attention computationally affordable while enabling explicit global interaction across tokens. In this way, Stage 3 complements the earlier SSM-based stages by emphasizing long-range dependencies and global contextual integration at the highest representation level.

blocks.en: 3.7 Scalable model variants
blocks.zh: 3.7 可扩展模型变体

blocks.en: We implement the backbone in four sizes: Micro, Mini, Tiny, and Small (Table 1 ). All variants share the same three-stage design and differ only in channel width, stage depth, and number of attention heads. Scaling capacity through width and depth, while keeping the architecture fixed, is common practice in hierarchical backbones and lets us study the effect of model size without changing the underlying structure.
blocks.zh: 我们以四个规模实施骨干:微型、微型、小型和小型(表1)。 所有变体都具有相同的三阶段设计,仅在信道宽度,舞台深度,注意力头数方面有所不同. 通过宽度和深度增强能力,同时保持架构固定,是等级骨干中常见的做法,让我们研究模型大小的影响而不改变基础结构.

blocks.en: This scalability serves two purposes. It lets the same design fit different computational budgets, from lightweight to more expressive models, and it enables a controlled study of how representation quality changes with capacity under a fixed CNN–SSM–Attention formulation. The models remain compact overall, ranging from 0.21M parameters for Micro to 4.17M for Small, which is lightweight relative to typical transformer-based ECG backbones. Unless stated otherwise, we use the Small variant for the main pretraining and downstream experiments.
blocks.zh: 这种可伸缩性有两个目的。 它让同样的设计适合不同的计算预算,从轻量级模型到更显式的模型,并且能够对在CNN-SSM-Attention定式下表现质量如何随容量变化进行有控制的研究. 这些型号整体仍保持紧凑,从Micro的0.21M参数到Small的4.17M参数不等,相对于典型的变压器型ECG主干线来说是轻量级的. 除非另有说明,否则我们使用Small变体进行主要的预训和下游实验.

blocks.en: 4 Self-Supervised Pretraining
blocks.zh: 4 自我监督 预 训

blocks.en: We pretrain the proposed backbone on unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings using a joint-embedding predictive objective inspired by JEPA [ 2 ] . The model is not trained to reconstruct the raw ECG waveform. Instead, it predicts the latent representation of masked temporal regions from a corrupted multilead input. This design encourages the encoder to learn waveform representations that preserve local morphology, temporal context, and cross-lead structure in feature space.
blocks.zh: 我们利用受JEPA[2]启发的联合组合预测目标,在无标签的12条铅ECG记录上预先培训拟议的骨干。 该模型没有经过训练来重建原始ECG波形. 相反,它预测被掩盖的时间区域的潜在代表性来自腐败的多铅投入。 这种设计鼓励编码器学习波形表示法,在特征空间中保留局部形态,时间背景,以及跨铅结构.

Given a clean ECG segment 𝐗 ∈ ℝ 12 × T \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{12\times T} , a corrupted view 𝐗 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{X}} is generated before the online encoder. The clean signal 𝐗 \mathbf{X} is processed by the momentum target encoder, while the corrupted signal 𝐗 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{X}} is processed by the online encoder. The target encoder is updated as an exponential moving average of the online encoder: ξ ← m ​ ξ + ( 1 − m ) ​ θ , \xi\leftarrow m\xi+(1-m)\theta, (18) where θ \theta and ξ \xi denote the online and target encoder parameters, respectively, and m m is the momentum coefficient.

blocks.en: The predictor g ϕ g_{\phi} maps the online representation 𝐙 ~ 3 \tilde{\mathbf{Z}}_{3} to the target latent space. The loss is computed only over the masked temporal token set ℳ \mathcal{M} : ℒ JEPA = 1 | ℳ | ​ ∑ t ∈ ℳ SmoothL1 ⁡ ( g ϕ ​ ( 𝐙 ~ 3 ) t , sg ⁡ ( 𝐳 t ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{JEPA}}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{t\in\mathcal{M}}\mathrm{SmoothL1}\left(g_{\phi}(\tilde{\mathbf{Z}}_{3})_{t},\mathrm{sg}(\mathbf{z}_{t})\right), (19) where g ϕ ​ ( 𝐙 ~ 3 ) t g_{\phi}(\tilde{\mathbf{Z}}_{3})_{t} is the predicted latent vector at masked position t t , 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} is the corresponding target vector from the momentum encoder, and sg ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{sg}(\cdot) denotes stop-gradient. The corruption process is defined by two operations. First, random temporal span masks are sampled at the final latent temporal resolution with an overall masking ratio of 75%. Each selected token corresponds to a temporal region in the input signal; therefore, the sampled mask is expanded back to the waveform domain and the corresponding raw ECG regions are corrupted before entering the online encoder. This differs from ViT-style masked modeling, where explicit mask tokens are inserted into the token sequence. In our case, the encoder receives a corrupted waveform rather than learnable mask-token embeddings. Second, lead dropout is applied with probability 0.25 by selecting one or two complete leads and replacing them with noise. This simulates missing or unreliable channels and encourages the model to exploit cross-lead redundancy.
blocks.zh: 腐败过程由两项行动界定。 首先,在最终潜在时间分辨率时抽取随机时间跨膜样本,总体遮盖比率为75%。 每个选定的令牌对应输入信号中的一个时区;因此,被采样的遮罩被扩展回波形域,相应的原始ECG区域在进入在线编码器前被腐蚀. 这与ViT风格的蒙面造型不同,在标志序列中插入明显的蒙面标志. 在我们的情况中,编码器接收到一个腐烂的波形,而不是可以学习的面具-托肯嵌入. 其次,采用铅脱落概率为0.25,选择一两个完整的线索,代之以噪音。 这模拟了缺少或不可靠的通道,并鼓励模型利用跨头冗余.

blocks.en: Overall, the proposed pretraining scheme learns by predicting clean final-stage latent targets from corrupted multilead ECG inputs. By aligning the predictor output with 𝐙 3 \mathbf{Z}_{3} , the objective directly optimizes the representation level used for downstream classification.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,拟议的预训计划通过预测腐败的多头ECG投入产生的清洁的最后阶段潜在目标来学习。 通过将预测器输出与Z 3\mathbf{Z}_{3}对齐,目标直接优化了用于下游分类的表示水平.

blocks.en: 4.1 LoRA-Based Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.1 基于LORA的适应

blocks.en: In addition to full fine-tuning, we evaluate parameter-efficient adaptation using LoRA. For a pretrained linear layer with frozen weight 𝐖 0 ∈ ℝ d out × d in \mathbf{W}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{\mathrm{out}}\times d_{\mathrm{in}}} , LoRA introduces a trainable low-rank update: 𝐖 LoRA = 𝐖 0 + α r ​ 𝐁𝐀 , \mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{LoRA}}=\mathbf{W}_{0}+\frac{\alpha}{r}\mathbf{B}\mathbf{A}, (20) where 𝐀 ∈ ℝ r × d in \mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{r\times d_{\mathrm{in}}} and 𝐁 ∈ ℝ d out × r \mathbf{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{\mathrm{out}}\times r} are trainable matrices, r r is the adapter rank, and α \alpha is the scaling factor. In our backbone, LoRA is applied to selected linear projections inside the encoder, including attention and MLP-related linear layers. During LoRA adaptation, the original pretrained weights 𝐖 0 \mathbf{W}_{0} remain frozen, while only the low-rank adapter parameters are updated. The attention-pooling layer and classification head remain fully trainable.

LoRA改造期间,原有的预训重量W 0\mathbf{W}_{0}仍然被冻结,而只有低级适配参数更新. 注意力集中层和分类头仍然完全可以训练。

blocks.en: This setting provides a parameter-efficient way to adapt the SSL-pretrained ECG encoder to downstream datasets. It reduces the number of trainable encoder parameters, helps preserve the pretrained representation, and can be useful when labeled ECG data are limited. In our experiments, LoRA uses rank r = 32 r=32 , scaling factor α = 128 \alpha=128 , and dropout 0.05.
blocks.zh: 这个设置提供了一个参数效率高的方法,可以将SSL预选的ECG编码器适应下游数据集. 它可以减少可训练编码器参数的数量,有助于保存预训的表示,并在标注ECG数据有限时有用. 在我们的实验中,LORA使用等级 r = 32 r = 32, 缩放系数 α = 128\ alpha = 128, 和辍学 0.05。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: This section presents the experimental evaluation of the proposed framework. We first describe the experimental setup, including datasets, preprocessing, implementation details, and evaluation protocol. We then evaluate the backbone variants under supervised training from scratch, followed by JEPA-style transfer under full-label and reduced-label settings. Finally, we compare the proposed method with existing 12-lead ECG classification approaches.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍对拟议框架的试验性评价。 我们首先描述实验设置,包括数据集,预处理,执行细节,评价协议. 然后,我们从零开始评估受监督培训的骨干变体,然后在全标签和减标签设置下评估JEPA式转移。 最后,我们将拟议方法与现有的12个牵头ECG分类方法进行比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We use four public 12-lead ECG datasets in this study. CODE-15% is used for self-supervised pretraining, whereas CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL are used for downstream evaluation. CODE-15% contains 345,779 ECG records from 233,770 patients and is used only as an unlabeled waveform source. CPSC2018 contains 6,877 recordings sampled at 500 Hz with durations between 6 and 60 s. Chapman-Shaoxing contains 10,646 10-second recordings sampled at 500 Hz. PTB-XL contains 21,837 10-second recordings from 18,885 subjects and is provided at both 100 Hz and 500 Hz.
blocks.zh: 我们在本研究中使用了4个公共的12头ECG数据集. CODE-15%用于自我监督的预训,而CPSC2018,Chapman-Shaoxing和PTB-XL则用于下游评价. CODE 15% 包含 233,770名患者的345,779ECG记录,仅用作无标签的波形源. CPSC2018载有在500赫兹取样的6,877份录音,持续时间为6至60秒。 Chapman-Shaoxing载有在500赫兹取样的10,646份10秒录音。 PTB-XL载有18,885个主题的21,837份10秒录音,在100赫兹和500赫兹同时提供。

blocks.en: For downstream evaluation, CPSC2018 is formulated as a 9-class single-label task with Normal/SNR (normal sinus rhythm), AF (atrial fibrillation), IAVB (first-degree atrioventricular block), LBBB (left bundle branch block), RBBB (right bundle branch block), PAC (premature atrial contraction), PVC (premature ventricular contraction), STD (ST-segment depression), and STE (ST-segment elevation). Chapman–Shaoxing is evaluated under a 4-class rhythm setting with AFIB (atrial fibrillation), GSVT (general supraventricular tachycardia), SB (sinus bradycardia), and SR (sinus rhythm). PTB-XL follows the diagnostic superclass protocol with NORM (normal ECG), MI (myocardial infarction), STTC (ST/T change), CD (conduction disturbance), and HYP (hypertrophy).
blocks.zh: 对于下游评价,CPSC2018被制定为9级单标签任务,包括:Normal/SNR(正常的鼻音节律)、AF(试射纤维)、IAVB(一级静脉管区块)、LBB(左捆枝区块)、RBB(右捆枝区块)、PAC(先天收缩)、PVC(先天通风收缩)、STD(ST-隔膜低压)和STE(ST-隔膜高压)。 Chapman–Shaoxing在4级节奏设定下被评价,有AFIB(试纤维化),GSVT(一般超致心律),SB(sinus bradycardia)和SR(sinus hythm). PTB-XL遵循诊断超级协议,与NORM(正常ECG),MI(心肌梗塞),STTC(ST/T改变),CD(导线扰动),HYP(Hypertrophy).

blocks.en: For data splitting, CPSC2018 follows a fold-based protocol with folds 1–8 for training, fold 9 for validation, and fold 10 for testing. Chapman-Shaoxing uses a stratified 80/10/10 train/validation/test split. PTB-XL preserves the official patient-wise split, using folds 1–8 for training, fold 9 for validation, and fold 10 for testing. The train sets remain imbalanced, with maximum-to-minimum class ratios of 8.58, 5.38, and 17.45 for CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL, respectively.

All datasets are converted to a unified input format. Signals are reordered to the canonical lead arrangement { I , II , III , aVR , aVL , aVF , V1 , V2 , V3 , V4 , V5 , V6 } \{\mathrm{I},\mathrm{II},\mathrm{III},\mathrm{aVR},\mathrm{aVL},\mathrm{aVF},\mathrm{V1},\mathrm{V2},\mathrm{V3},\mathrm{V4},\mathrm{V5},\mathrm{V6}\} .
Recordings are resampled to 100 Hz and represented as fixed-length 10-second segments, yielding 12 × 1000 12\times 1000 waveform tensors. Longer recordings are center-cropped, whereas shorter recordings are resized to the target length using linear interpolation. During training, a zero-phase fourth-order Butterworth band-pass filter is applied before per-lead normalization.
blocks.zh:
所有数据集都转换为统一的输入格式. 信号重排到罐头铅安排 {I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6}\ matthrm{I},\mathrm{II},\mathrm{III},\mathrm{aVR},\mathrm{V1},\ matthrm{V1},\ matthrm{V3},\ matthrm{V4},\ matthrm{V5},\ matthrm{V6}。
记录被重印到100赫兹,并以固定长度10秒的片段表示,产生12×1000 12\时1000波形的变速器. 较长的录音是中央编译的,而较短的录音则通过线性插值调整到目标长度. 在训练期间,在每头正常化之前,使用一个零级的第四顺序巴特沃思波段-通过过滤器。

blocks.en: 5.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 5.2 详细执行情况

blocks.en: All models are implemented in PyTorch and trained with fixed-size 12 × 1000 12\times 1000 ECG inputs. For self-supervised pretraining, the backbone is trained on 345,779 unlabeled CODE-15% recordings. We use AdamW with learning rate 7.4 × 10 − 5 7.4\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.05, and ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) . Training is performed for 50K optimization steps with batch size 16 and gradient accumulation over 8 steps, resulting in an effective batch size of 128. The learning rate is linearly warmed up for 4K steps and then decayed with a cosine schedule using a minimum learning-rate ratio of 0.01. Gradients are clipped to a maximum norm of 1.0. The momentum target encoder is updated by exponential moving average, with the decay coefficient scheduled from 0.998 to 0.9999.
blocks.zh: 所有模型均在PyTorch中实施,并经过固定尺寸的12×100012\times1000ECG输入的训练. 对于自我监督的预训,骨干在345,779个无标签的CODE-15%的录音上进行了训练. 我们使用学习率7.4×10−5 7.4\times 10×5},体重衰减0.05,和(β 1,β 2) = (0.9, 0.95) (\β_{1},\β_{2}) = (0.9, 0.95). 培训为50K优化步骤,分批16次,梯度累积8次,有效分批128次。 学习速率为4K步的线性加热,然后使用0.01的最低学习速率,以余弦表衰减. 梯度被剪切到最大规范为1.0. 动力目标编码器通过指数移动平均值更新,衰变系数计划从0.998到0.9999.

blocks.en: The self-supervised objective is masked latent prediction with a Smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss ( β = 1.0 ) (\beta=1.0) . The predictor is a transformer-style module with four blocks, four attention heads, dropout 0.1, and hidden dimension d p = max ⁡ ( 1.5 ​ C 3 , 128 ) d_{p}=\max(1.5C_{3},128) , where C 3 C_{3} denotes the final encoder dimension. For the Small backbone, C 3 = 256 C_{3}=256 and d p = 384 d_{p}=384 . The online branch receives the corrupted ECG signal, whereas the momentum branch processes the clean signal and provides stop-gradient latent targets.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的目标是一个蒙面潜伏的预测,以平滑-1 1\ell\%1}损失(β=1.0)(\β=1.0). 预测器是一个变压器式模块,有四个块,四个注意头,退位0.1,隐藏的维度d = max ⁡(1.5 C 3,128) d_{p}=\max(1.5 C_{3},128),其中C 3 C_{3}表示最后编码器的维度. 小骨干,C = 256 C = 3 = 256,d = 384 d_{p}=384). 在线分支接收腐烂的ECG信号,而动力分支处理干净的信号,并提供停止升级的潜在目标.

blocks.en: The masking policy is fixed during pretraining. Random temporal spans are sampled at the latent temporal resolution using a masking ratio of 75% and span lengths of 120–400 ms. The sampled masks are expanded back to the waveform domain, where the corresponding ECG regions are replaced by learned lead-wise masking values with small additive noise. Lead dropout is applied with probability 0.25 by replacing one or two complete leads with noise.
blocks.zh: 蒙面政策是在预训期间确定的. 用75%的遮掩率和120至400毫秒的跨度对潜在时间分辨率进行随机时间间隔取样。 被采样的口罩被扩展回波形域,其中相应的ECG区域被学习到的含铅遮罩值以小的添加噪音取代. 将一、两条完整的铅用噪音取代,从而以概率0.25来应用铅。

blocks.en: For downstream classification, an attention-pooling layer and a lightweight classification head are attached to the encoder. Models are trained for up to 50 epochs using AdamW, weight decay 0.05, cosine learning-rate decay, and a 5% warm-up ratio. We use batch size 16 with gradient accumulation over 2 steps. The checkpoint with the highest validation macro-F1 is selected for testing, and early stopping is applied. Class imbalance is handled using class-reweighted cross-entropy with inverse-square-root frequency weighting.
blocks.zh: 对于下游分类,在编码器上附加了注意池层和轻量级分类头. 对使用亚当W,重量衰减0.05,余弦学习率衰减,加热比5%的模型进行最多50个纪元的培训. 我们使用16号批量 梯度积分超过两步 具有最高验证宏-F1的检查点被选中进行测试,并应用提前停止. 班级不平衡的处理采用班级重压的交叉式,反平方根频率加权.

blocks.en: We consider three training modes. In scratch training, all parameters are optimized from random initialization. In full SSL fine-tuning, the pretrained encoder, attention-pooling layer, and classification head are updated jointly. In LoRA-based SSL adaptation, the pretrained encoder is frozen except for low-rank adapters inserted into selected linear layers, while the attention-pooling layer and classifier remain trainable. LoRA uses rank r = 32 r=32 , scaling factor α = 128 \alpha=128 , and dropout 0.05. The learning rates are 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for scratch training, 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} for full SSL fine-tuning, and 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for LoRA-based SSL adaptation. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU with 48 GB of memory.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑三种培训模式。 在划痕训练中,所有参数都通过随机初始化优化. 在全SSL的微调中,预先训练的编码器,注意力集成层,分类头共同更新. 在基于LORA的SSL适应中,除了插入到选定的线性层的低级适配器外,预训编码器被冻结,而注意力集成层和分类器仍然可以训练. LORA使用等级r=32r=32,缩放系数α=128\alpha=128,辍学率0.05。 学习率为:刮伤训练1×10−4 10×4 10×4 10×4 5 3×5 10×5 完全SSL微调,1×10×4 1×4 10×4 =4 ),为基于LORA的SSL调整. 所有实验均在单NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上进行,内存48GB.

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价协议

blocks.en: We report AUC, accuracy, macro-F1, and Cohen’s κ \kappa . Macro-F1 is treated as the primary metric because the downstream datasets contain imbalanced diagnostic or rhythm categories. AUC, accuracy, and κ \kappa are reported as complementary measures of class separability, overall correctness, and agreement beyond chance.
blocks.zh: 我们报告AUC、准确性、宏F1和Cohen的\kappa。 由于下游数据集包含不平衡的诊断或节奏类,Macro-F1被视作主要度量衡. AUC、准确度和ox\kappa作为分类可分离性、总体正确性以及超越机会的协议的补充措施。

blocks.en: For each downstream run, the checkpoint with the highest validation macro-F1 is selected for final test evaluation. In the reduced-label setting, we sample stratified subsets of the labeled training set using 1%, 5%, 10%, and 20% of the available training data. For each fraction, the same subset manifest is shared across scratch, SSL-Full, and SSL-LoRA to ensure matched comparisons. Each reduced-label experiment is repeated three times with different sampling seeds, and results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 每一个下游运行时,都会选择具有最高验证宏-F1的检查站进行最终测试评价. 在减标签设置中,我们使用1%、5%、10%和20%的现有培训数据,对分类培训集的子集进行抽样。 对于每个分数,相同的子集显示在划痕、SSL-Ful和SSL-LORA之间,以确保匹配的比较。 每个减标签实验以不同的采样种子重复三次,结果报告为平均值±\pm标准差.

blocks.en: 5.4 Supervised Baselines from Scratch
blocks.zh: 5.4 监督抽查基线

blocks.en: We first train the backbone family from random initialization, without any self-supervised pretraining. The goal is to see how model size affects performance before we add self-supervised learning. We test the four proposed variants, Micro, Mini, Tiny, and Small, which grow in size from 0.21M to 4.17M parameters and differ in channel width and the number of blocks.
blocks.zh: 我们首先训练骨干家族 从随机初始化, 没有任何自我监督的预训。 目标是在加入自我监督的学习之前,先看模型大小如何影响性能. 我们测试四个拟议变体,即Micro,Mini,Tiny,和Small,它们的尺寸从0.21M增加到4.17M参数,在信道宽度和区块数量上有所不同.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Scratch performance of the backbone variants on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL. All values are reported in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表3:CPSC2018,Chapman-Shaoxing和PTB-XL上的骨干变体性能. 所有数值按百分比报告。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows the results for the four variants. Small performs best overall. It gives the highest accuracy, macro-F1, and κ \kappa on both Chapman-Shaoxing and PTB-XL, and the highest AUC and κ \kappa on CPSC2018. The main exception is Mini, which gives a slightly higher macro-F1 than Small on CPSC2018 (75.25 vs. 74.56). Micro gives the highest AUC on PTB-XL.
blocks.zh: 表3显示了四个变体的结果. 总体来说,小成绩最好。 它给查普曼-肖克星和PTB-XL都给出了最高的准确度,宏-F1,和\kappa,CPSC2018上最高的AUC和\kappa. 主要例外是Mini,它在CPSC2018(75.25 vs 74.56)上给出的宏F1略高于Small. 微量给PTB-XL上最高的AUC.

blocks.en: The effect of model size is small and not always in the same direction. Larger models tend to give better results on Chapman-Shaoxing and PTB-XL, but the smaller models are still strong. For example, Micro (0.21M) matches or beats Small (4.17M) on PTB-XL AUC, and Mini (0.78M) is close to Small on all three datasets. Because many of the gaps between variants are small, we treat these differences as a general trend rather than a strict ranking. In practice, this is a useful property, since it shows that the model already works well even with very few parameters.
blocks.zh: 模型大小的效果很小,并不总是朝同一方向发展. 更大的模型往往能给查普曼-肖星和PTB-XL带来更好的结果,但较小的模型仍然很强. 例如,Micro(0.21M)在PTB-XL AUC上匹配或击败Small(4.17M),Mini(0.78M)在所有三个数据集上都接近Small. 由于变体之间的许多差距很小,我们将这些差异视为一个总的趋势,而不是严格的排名. 在实践中,这是一个有用的属性,因为它表明,即使参数很少,模型也已经运作良好。

blocks.en: Based on these results, we use the Small backbone for the self-supervised experiments. It gives the best or joint-best macro-F1 and κ \kappa on two of the three datasets and stays competitive on CPSC2018, so it is a reliable choice for studying JEPA-style pretraining. Mini is a good lightweight option when a smaller model is needed.
blocks.zh: 基于这些结果,我们利用小骨干进行自我监督的实验. 它为三个数据集中的两个提供了最佳或联合最佳的宏-F1和\kappa,并在CPSC2018上保持竞争力,因此它是研究JEPA风格预训的可靠选择. 当需要较小的模型时,迷你是一个很好的轻量级选项.

blocks.en: 5.5 Self-Supervised Pretraining and Downstream Transfer
blocks.zh: 5.5 自我监督的预训和下游转移

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether JEPA-style pretraining improves downstream ECG classification. The Small backbone is first pretrained on unlabeled CODE-15% recordings and then adapted to CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL. The purpose of this experiment is to compare the same architecture under three settings: supervised training from scratch, LoRA-based adaptation from the SSL-pretrained encoder, and full fine-tuning from the SSL-pretrained encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价JEPA式的预训是否改善了下游ECG分类. 小骨干首先在无标签CODE-15%的录音上进行预训,然后改编为CPSC2018,Chapman-Shaoxing,以及PTB-XL. 本实验的目的是在三种设置下比较相同的架构:从零开始的受监督训练,从SSL预装编码器开始基于LORA的改编,从SSL预装编码器开始完全微调.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows representative corruption examples under two temporal masking ratios. Random temporal span masks are sampled at the latent temporal resolution and expanded back to the waveform domain, where the corresponding ECG regions are corrupted before entering the online encoder. The 25% setting preserves more visible waveform morphology, whereas the 75% setting removes a larger portion of the temporal context and therefore imposes a harder latent prediction task. Lead dropout is also applied as an additional channel-level corruption. In the main transfer experiments, the temporal masking ratio is fixed at 75%, while the lower masking ratios are evaluated separately in the masking-sensitivity analysis. The target branch receives the corresponding clean ECG and provides latent targets through the momentum encoder; thus, the model predicts latent representations from partially corrupted ECG signals rather than reconstructing raw waveforms.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了两个时间遮盖比率下有代表性的腐败实例。 随机时间跨度口罩在潜在时间解析度上进行采样,并扩展回波形域,其中相应的ECG区域在进入在线编码器前被腐蚀. 25%的设定保留了更明显的波形形态,而75%的设定消除了时间背景的较大部分,因此增加了更硬的潜在预测任务. 铅辍学也是一种额外的渠道级腐败。 在主转移实验中,时间遮掩比固定为75%,而较低的遮掩比则在遮掩敏感度分析中单独评价. 目标分支接收相应的清洁ECG,并通过动力编码器提供潜在目标;因此,模型预测部分损坏ECG信号的潜在表示,而不是重建原始波形.

blocks.zh: (a) 25%的时间遮盖。

Temporal masks are sampled at the latent token resolution and projected back to the waveform domain before the online encoder. Lower masking preserves more visible waveform morphology, whereas higher masking imposes a stronger contextual prediction task. Lead dropout is applied as an additional channel-level corruption.
blocks.zh: 图5:具有代表性的ECG波形腐败在不同时间遮掩比率下. Temperal 口罩在潜在的符号分辨率上取样,并投射到网络编码器之前的波形域. 较低的遮盖保留了更可见的波形形态,而较高的遮盖则规定了更强的背景预测任务. 铅辍学是一种额外的渠道级腐败。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Transfer results of the Small backbone on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL. SSL-pretrained models are adapted using LoRA and full fine-tuning. All values are reported in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表4:CPSC2018、Chapman-Shaoxing和PTB-XL小骨干转移结果。 SSL预装模型使用LORA和全微调进行改造. 所有数值按百分比报告。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the full-label transfer results. The results show that SSL pretraining provides clear gains on CPSC2018 and Chapman-Shaoxing. On CPSC2018, SSL-Full achieves the best performance across all metrics, indicating that the pretrained encoder remains useful even when full labeled data are available. On Chapman-Shaoxing, SSL-LoRA gives the strongest results, suggesting that parameter-efficient adaptation can preserve and exploit the pretrained representation effectively.
blocks.zh: 表4报告全标签转帐结果。 结果显示,SSL预训为CPSC2018和查普曼-肖克星提供了明显的收获. 在CPSC2018上,SSL-Full在所有度量衡上实现最佳性能,表明即使有完整的标注数据,预训编码器仍然有用. 在查普曼-肖克宁(Chapman-Shaoxing)上,SSL-Lora给出了最强的结果,表明参数高效的适应能够有效保存和利用预先训练过的表示.

blocks.en: On PTB-XL, the effect is more metric-dependent. SSL-LoRA gives the highest AUC and SSL-Full gives the highest accuracy, whereas scratch training remains better in macro-F1 and κ \kappa . This indicates that SSL initialization improves ranking-oriented separability but does not uniformly improve the final class-balanced decision metrics under full supervision. Given the stronger class imbalance in PTB-XL, this behavior suggests that SSL pretraining is beneficial but its impact depends on the downstream label distribution and adaptation mode.
blocks.zh: 在PTB-XL上,效果更依赖度量. SSL-LORA给予最高的AUC,SSL-Full给予最高的精确度,而刮伤训练在宏-F1和\kappa中仍然较好. 这表明,SSL初始化改进了以排名为导向的分离性,但并没有统一改进在全面监督下的最终分类平衡决策衡量标准。 鉴于PTB-XL的班级不平衡性较强,这种行为表明SSL预训是有益的,但其影响取决于下游的标签分配和适应模式.

blocks.en: 5.6 Low-Label Transfer Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.6 低标签转移分析

blocks.en: We further evaluate downstream transfer under limited supervision. For each dataset, we sample stratified subsets containing 1%, 5%, 10%, and 20% of the labeled training data. The same subset manifest is used across scratch, SSL-LoRA, and SSL-Full to ensure matched comparisons. Each experiment is repeated over three sampling seeds, and results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估在有限监督下的下游转移。 对于每个数据集,我们抽样分层子集,包含1%,5%,10%和20%的标注培训数据. 相同的子集列表被使用到划痕,SSL-LORA,和SSL-Full,以确保匹配的比较. 每个实验在三个取样种子上重复,结果报告为平均值±\pm标准差.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Low-label transfer results on CPSC2018 using different fractions of the labeled training data. SSL-pretrained models are adapted using LoRA and full fine-tuning. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three runs, in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表5:使用标签培训数据的不同分数对CPSC2018进行低标签传输的结果. SSL预装模型使用LORA和全微调进行改造. 结果报告为平均±\pm标准差,以百分比计算。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Low-label transfer results on Chapman-Shaoxing using different fractions of the labeled training data. SSL-pretrained models are adapted using LoRA and full fine-tuning. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three runs, in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表6:使用标签培训数据的不同分数对查普曼-肖克辛进行低标签传输的结果. SSL预装模型使用LORA和全微调进行改造. 结果报告为平均±\pm标准差,以百分比计算。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Low-label transfer results on PTB-XL using different fractions of the labeled training data. SSL-pretrained models are adapted using LoRA and full fine-tuning. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three runs, in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表7:PTB-XL使用标签培训数据不同分数的低标签传输结果. SSL预装模型使用LORA和全微调进行改造. 结果报告为平均±\pm标准差,以百分比计算。

blocks.en: Tables 5 – 7 report the reduced-label transfer results. In general, SSL initialization provides the largest gains when the amount of labeled data is small. The effect is most pronounced on CPSC2018 and Chapman-Shaoxing, where SSL-based adaptation consistently improves over scratch across all training fractions. On CPSC2018, full fine-tuning gives the strongest overall performance at most fractions, while LoRA remains competitive and gives the highest AUC at selected fractions. On Chapman-Shaoxing, LoRA is particularly effective at the lowest label fraction, whereas full fine-tuning becomes slightly stronger as more labels are available.
blocks.zh: 表5 – 7报告减标签转移结果. 一般而言,SSL初始化在标注数据量小时提供最大的收益. 这对CPSC2018和Chapman-Shaoxing的影响最为明显,因为在那里,基于SSL的适应性在所有培训部分都持续改善。 在CPSC2018上,全微调在大多数分数上给出了最强的整体性能,而LORA仍然具有竞争力,并在选定的分数上给出最高的AUC. 在查普曼-绍兴,LORA在最低的标签分数上特别有效,而随着更多标签的提供,完整的微调会变得稍强一些.

blocks.en: The trend on PTB-XL is more moderate. SSL-based adaptation improves most metrics at 1%, 5%, and 10%, indicating that the pretrained encoder provides a useful representation prior under limited supervision. At 20%, the differences become smaller and metric-dependent, with scratch remaining competitive for κ \kappa while SSL-based models retain advantages in AUC, accuracy, or macro-F1. This behavior is consistent with the stronger class imbalance of PTB-XL and suggests that the benefit of SSL initialization depends on both the label budget and the downstream label distribution.
blocks.zh: PTB-XL上的趋势较为温和. 基于SSL的适应改进了大部分的度量衡,分别为1%、5%和10%,这表明在有限的监督下,预先培训的编码器在前提供了有用的说明。 在20%时,差异会变小,并依赖衡量标准,在oble\kappa上刮痕仍然具有竞争力,而基于SSL的模型则保留了AUC,精度,或宏F1的优势. 这种行为与PTB-XL更强烈的类失衡是一致的,并暗示SSL初始化的好处取决于标签预算和下游标签分布.

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that the JEPA-style pretraining is most beneficial in low-label regimes. The gains are especially clear when only a small portion of the training set is available, supporting the role of the pretrained encoder as a transferable initialization for data-efficient ECG classification.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果显示,JEPA式的预训在低标签制度中最为有益. 当只有一小部分培训内容时,收益就特别明显,支持预先培训的编码器作为数据高效ECG分类的可转让初始化。

blocks.en: 5.7 Sensitivity to Masking Ratio
blocks.zh: 5.7 对遮盖比率的敏感性

blocks.en: We further examine the effect of the temporal masking ratio used during JEPA-style pretraining. In the main experiments, the masking ratio is fixed at 75%, which defines the default pretraining configuration used for the reported SSL transfer results. To assess the influence of corruption strength, we additionally pretrain the Small backbone using lower masking ratios of 25% and 50%. The downstream evaluation is conducted using full fine-tuning on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL, while keeping the backbone, pretraining data, downstream splits, optimizer, and adaptation protocol unchanged. To isolate the effect of the masking ratio, this analysis uses full fine-tuning for all masking configurations; LoRA-based adaptation is evaluated separately under the default 75% masking configuration in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查在JEPA式预训中使用的时间遮掩率的影响。 在主要实验中,遮掩率固定在75%,这定义了用于所报告SSL传输结果的默认预训配置. 为了评估腐败势力的影响,我们还利用25%和50%的较低遮掩率,对小骨干进行预先培训。 下游评价采用CPSC2018,查普曼-肖星和PTB-XL的全微调进行,同时保持主干,预训数据,下游拆分,优化,适应协议不变. 为了隔离遮掩比的效果,本分析对所有遮掩配置使用全微调;基于LORA的适应在表4默认的75%遮掩配置下单独评价.

blocks.en: Table 8 : Sensitivity of JEPA-style pretraining to the temporal masking ratio using the Small backbone and full fine-tuning. The 75% setting corresponds to the default configuration used in the main experiments. All values are reported in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表8:JEPA式预训对时间遮盖比的敏感性,使用小骨干和全微调. 75%的设置符合主要实验中使用的默认配置. 所有数值按百分比报告。

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the masking-ratio sensitivity results. The effect of the masking ratio is not monotonic across datasets or metrics. On CPSC2018, the 50% masking ratio gives the strongest decision-level performance, achieving 83.13% accuracy, 79.19% macro-F1, and 80.26% κ \kappa . The default 75% setting remains slightly higher in AUC, but the 50% setting provides better class-balanced and agreement-based performance. This suggests that an intermediate corruption level can provide a favorable balance between preserving discriminative waveform morphology and enforcing contextual latent prediction.
blocks.zh: 表8报告了蒙面-鼠标敏感性结果。 遮盖比率的效果不是单调跨越数据集或度量衡. 在CPSC2018上,50%的遮掩率给出了最强的决策级别性能,实现了83.13%的精确度,79.19%的宏-F1和80.26%的\kappa. 默认的75%设置在AUC中仍然略高,但50%的设置提供了更好的阶级平衡和基于协议的性能. 这表明,中间一级腐败可以在保护歧视性波形形态和执行背景潜在预测之间提供有利的平衡。

blocks.en: On Chapman-Shaoxing, the three masking ratios produce relatively close results. The 50% setting gives the highest macro-F1, reaching 94.29%, while the default 75% setting gives the highest accuracy and κ \kappa . The 25% setting is also competitive, but remains slightly below the 50% and 75% configurations in the main decision metrics. These results indicate that the proposed JEPA-style objective is stable on this rhythm-classification dataset, with only modest variation across masking ratios.
blocks.zh: 在查普曼-肖克辛问题上,三个蒙面比率产生相对接近的结果. 50%的设置给出了最高的宏- F1, 达到94.29%, 而默认的75%的设置给出了最高的精确度和\ kappa 。 25%的设定也具有竞争力,但仍略低于主要决策指标中的50%和75%的配置。 这些结果表明,拟议中的JEPA式目标在这个节奏分类数据集上是稳定的,在遮掩比率上差异不大。

blocks.en: On PTB-XL, the trend differs from CPSC2018 and Chapman-Shaoxing. The 50% masking ratio obtains the highest macro-F1, whereas the 75% setting gives the best AUC and accuracy, and the 25% setting gives the highest κ \kappa . This metric-dependent behavior is consistent with the stronger class imbalance and diagnostic heterogeneity of PTB-XL. In particular, lower or intermediate masking ratios may better preserve morphology-sensitive diagnostic cues, while stronger masking can improve overall separability and accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在PTB-XL上,趋势与CPSC2018和Chapman-Shaoxing不同. 50%的遮掩率获得最高的宏-F1,而75%的设置给出了最好的AUC和准确性,25%的设置给出了最高的 ob \kappa 。 这种依赖测量的行为与PTB-XL更强烈的阶级不平衡和诊断异质性是一致的. 特别是,较低的或中间的遮盖比率可以更好地保存形态敏感诊断提示,而更强的遮盖可以提高整体的分隔性和准确性.

blocks.en: Overall, the sensitivity analysis shows that the masking ratio influences the balance between morphology preservation and contextual prediction difficulty. The 75% configuration remains a strong and consistent default, especially in terms of AUC and overall accuracy, and is therefore retained for the main transfer experiments. At the same time, the 50% results show that an intermediate corruption level can improve macro-F1 on all three datasets, suggesting that masking strength is an important design factor for ECG latent predictive pretraining.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,灵敏度分析显示,遮掩比影响形态保存与背景预测难度之间的平衡. 75%的配置仍然是强烈和一贯的默认,特别是在AUC和整体准确性方面,因此被保留用于主转移实验. 同时,50%的结果显示,中间腐败水平可以改善所有三个数据集的宏观-F1,这表明遮掩强度是ECG潜在预测预训的重要设计因素.

blocks.en: 5.8 Qualitative Interpretability Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.8 定性解释分析

blocks.en: To complement the quantitative results, we perform a simple qualitative analysis of the Small backbone. The aim is not to explain individual decisions clinically, but to check whether the model responds to meaningful parts of the ECG waveform. We use two attribution methods. Grad-CAM++ [ 4 ] is applied to the Stage 2 representation, the last temporally localized feature map before the global self-attention stage, giving a class-specific view of the time regions that contribute to the prediction. Attention rollout [ 1 ] is then computed over the Stage 3 self-attention blocks to show how information is combined in the final stage. Since the two maps capture different aspects, class-specific attribution and attention-based information flow, we show them together for each example.
blocks.zh: 为了补充量化结果,我们对小骨干进行了简单的定性分析. 其目的不是在临床上解释个人的决定,而是检查模型是否对ECG波形中有意义的部分作出反应. 我们使用两种归属方法。 Grad-CAM++ [4] 应用于第2阶段的表示,这是全球自觉阶段前最后一张时间定位特征图,给出了对预测作出贡献的时间区域的具体分类观点. 然后从第3阶段自我注意区块计算出注意展开[1],以显示信息如何在最后阶段结合。 由于这两幅地图捕捉到不同的方面,分类的归属和基于关注的信息流,所以我们以每个例子一起显示它们.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows representative correct and incorrect predictions. In the correct PTB-XL NORM example (Fig. 6(a) ), both maps mainly highlight regions around the repeated beats, in particular near the QRS complexes. In the NORM → \rightarrow MI case (Fig. 6(b) ), the highlighted regions shift toward parts of the signal involving the ST segment and T-wave. This does not confirm that the prediction is clinically correct, but it suggests that the error is linked to waveform regions plausibly related to the confused class. A similar pattern appears in the CPSC2018 Normal → \rightarrow IAVB case (Fig. 6(c) ), where the maps concentrate around beat-level structures rather than unrelated parts of the signal.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了有代表性的正确和不正确的预测。 在正确的PTB-XL NORM例子(图6(a))中,这两幅地图主要突出显示连续拍周围的区域,特别是在QRS复合体附近. 在NORM ~\右旋MI(图6(b))中,突出区域转向部分涉及ST段和T波的信号. 这并不证实预测在临床上是正确的,但这表明误差与波形区域相关联,与混淆类相关联。 类似图案出现在CPSC2018 Normal →\rightarrow IAVB case(图6(c))中,地图集中围绕节拍结构而不是信号的无关部分.

blocks.en: Overall, these examples suggest that the model tends to respond to structured regions of the ECG and that its errors are often linked to less regular or ambiguous segments. We treat this as qualitative support only, complementing the classification metrics rather than providing a clinical interpretation.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些例子表明,模型倾向于对ECG的结构化区域作出反应,其错误往往与不太固定或模棱两可的部分有关。 我们仅将此视为质量支持,是对分类指标的补充,而不是提供临床解释。

blocks.en: 5.9 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 5.9 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare the proposed hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention model with recent 12-lead ECG classification methods. The comparison is organized into three parts. First, we evaluate the reduced-label setting on CPSC2018 and PTB-XL using only 20% of the labeled training data, which is particularly useful for assessing the transfer value of self-supervised pretraining. Second, we report full-label results on CPSC2018 and PTB-XL under the fixed-split protocol used in the main experiments. Third, we present a separate comparison on Chapman-Shaoxing. Throughout, we also include 10-fold cross-validation results for our variants as an additional robustness check. These 10-fold results are not intended to replace the fixed-split comparison with prior work, but to verify that the observed trends are not tied to a single data split.
blocks.zh: 我们把拟议的混合式CNN-SSM-注意模式与最近的12头ECG分类方法进行比较。 比较分为三部分。 首先,我们只使用20%的标签培训数据来评估CPSC2018和PTB-XL上的减标签设置,这对评估自我监督的预训的转移值特别有用. 第二,我们报告CPSC2018和PTB-XL在主要实验中使用的固定分解协议下的全标签结果。 第三,我们单独比较一下查普曼 -肖星 在整个过程中,我们还将我们的变体的10倍交叉验证结果作为额外的强性检查. 这10倍的结果并不是要取代与以前工作的固定分割比较,而是要核实观察到的趋势不是与一个数据分割挂钩的。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports the comparison at 20% labeled training data. Two main observations can be made. First, even without self-supervised initialization, the proposed backbone provides a strong supervised baseline. The random-initialized variant improves over the random-initialized baseline of Ma et al. on both datasets and remains competitive with several self-supervised baselines. This supports the effectiveness of the proposed architecture itself. Second, JEPA-style pretraining provides clear gains in the low-label regime, especially on CPSC2018. On this dataset, SSL-Full achieves the best accuracy, macro-F1, and κ \kappa , while SSL-LoRA obtains the best AUC. These results show that the pretrained representation transfers effectively when labeled supervision is limited.
blocks.zh: 表9按20%的标注培训数据作了比较。 可以提出两个主要意见。 首先,即使没有自我监督的初始化,拟议的主干线也提供了一个强有力的监督基线。 随机初始化的变体在两个数据集上都比随机初始化的马等人基线有所改进,并且仍然与多个自我监督的基线具有竞争力. 这支持拟议架构本身的有效性。 其次,JEPA式的预训在低标签制度上,特别是在CPSC2018上提供了明显的收益. 在这个数据集上,SSL-Full实现最佳精度,宏-F1和&kappa,而SSL-LORA获得最佳AUC. 这些结果表明,在贴上标签的监督时,经过预先培训的有效代表转让是有限的。

blocks.en: On PTB-XL, the improvement from pretraining is more moderate. The proposed variants remain competitive with the matched baselines, but the gains are metric-dependent. SSL-LoRA gives the highest macro-F1 among the compared methods, whereas the random-initialized backbone gives the highest κ \kappa . This suggests that, for PTB-XL, the proposed backbone already provides a strong supervised representation, while JEPA-style pretraining adds a smaller and less uniform benefit than on CPSC2018.
blocks.zh: 在PTB-XL上,比预训的改进较为温和. 拟议变式与相应的基线保持竞争力,但收益取决于衡量标准。 SSL-LORA在比较方法中给出了最高的宏-F1,而随机初始化的主干线给出了最高的&kappa 。 这表明,对于PTB-XL而言,拟议的骨干已经提供了强有力的监督代表,而JEPA式的预训增加了比CPSC-2018上更小和更统一的好处.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Comparison at 20% labeled training data on CPSC2018 and PTB-XL. All values are reported in percentage (%). Bold values indicate the best result within each dataset and metric.
blocks.zh: 表9:关于CPSC-2018和PTB-XL的20%标签培训数据的比较。 所有数值按百分比报告。 粗体值表示每个数据集和度量中的最佳结果。

blocks.en: Table 10 reports the full-label comparison. Under the fixed-split protocol, the proposed method achieves the strongest overall performance on CPSC2018. SSL-Full obtains the best AUC, accuracy, macro-F1, and κ \kappa , showing that JEPA-style initialization remains useful even when the full labeled training set is available. The random-initialized backbone is also strong, which further supports the contribution of the proposed hybrid architecture.
blocks.zh: 表10报告全标签的比较。 在固定分割协议下,建议的方法在CPSC2018上实现了最强的整体性能. SSL-Full获得最好的AUC,精度,宏F1和 $\kappa ,表明JEPA式的初始化即使在有完整的标签培训集的情况下仍然有用. 随机初始化的骨干也是很强的,这进一步支持了拟议的混合结构的贡献.

blocks.en: The 10-fold cross-validation results provide additional evidence for the stability of these trends on CPSC2018. SSL-LoRA gives the highest accuracy, macro-F1, and κ \kappa , while SSL-Full gives the highest AUC. This indicates that both full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient adaptation can benefit from the pretrained representation, and that the advantage is not limited to one fixed split.
blocks.zh: 10倍的交叉验证结果为CPSC2018上这些趋势的稳定性提供了更多的证据. SSL-LORA给出的精度最高,宏F1和&kappa,而SSL-Full给出的AUC最高. 这表明,全面微调和参数效率高的适应都可以从预先培训的表述中受益,优势不仅限于固定的分割.

blocks.en: On PTB-XL, the comparison is more nuanced. Prior task-specific self-supervised methods achieve the highest fixed-split AUC and accuracy, while our random-initialized backbone achieves the strongest macro-F1 and κ \kappa among the fixed-split results reported in the table. In the 10-fold setting, SSL-LoRA gives the highest AUC and accuracy, and a marginally higher κ \kappa , while the random-initialized model gives the highest macro-F1. These results suggest that, on PTB-XL, JEPA-style pretraining can improve ranking-oriented or overall metrics, but it does not consistently improve class-balanced decision metrics after adaptation. This behavior is likely related to the stronger class imbalance of PTB-XL.
blocks.zh: 在PTB-XL上,比较更为细微. 先前的任务特定自我监督的方法实现最高的固定分裂AUC和精度,而我们随机初始化的主干线在表中报告的固定分裂结果中实现最强的宏-F1和oble\kappa. 在10倍设置中,SSL-LORA给出最高的AUC和精确度,并给出一个相配的更高单方\kappa,而随机初始化的模型给出最高的宏F1. 这些结果表明,在PTB-XL上,JEPA式的预训可以改进以排名为导向的或总体的衡量标准,但是在适应后并没有始终如一地改进阶级平衡的决策衡量标准. 这种行为可能与PTB-XL更强烈的阶级不平衡有关.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Full-label results and comparison with recent ECG classification methods on CPSC2018 and PTB-XL. All values are reported in percentage (%).
blocks.zh: 表10:关于CPSC-2018和PTB-XL的全标签结果和与最近的ECG分类方法的比较。 所有数值按百分比报告。

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that the proposed backbone is competitive with recent ECG classification methods across different supervision levels and evaluation protocols. JEPA-style pretraining provides the clearest benefit in the reduced-label setting and on CPSC2018, while its effect on PTB-XL is more dependent on the metric and adaptation strategy. This suggests that the proposed architecture can serve as a strong supervised baseline and as an effective platform for further ECG-specific self-supervised learning.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果表明,拟议的骨干结构具有不同监督级别和评价协议的最新ECG分类方法的竞争力。 JEPA式的预训在减标签设置和CPSC2018上提供了最明显的好处,而其对PTB-XL的影响则更依赖于衡量和适应战略. 这表明,拟议架构可作为强有力的监督基线,并成为进一步开展ECG特定自我监督学习的有效平台。

blocks.en: For Chapman-Shaoxing, we report a separate comparison under the four-class rhythm setting of AFIB, GSVT, SB, and SR [ 27 ] . We use 10-fold cross-validation and report the mean and standard deviation across folds. As a reference, we include the validation baseline reported by Zheng et al. [ 27 ] , which uses an XGBoost classifier with age, gender, and 230 handcrafted ECG features. In contrast, our model operates directly on the raw 12-lead ECG waveform without demographic variables or engineered clinical descriptors.
blocks.zh: 对于查普曼-肖克辛,我们报告在AFIB,GSVT,SB,和SR[27]的四级节奏设置下进行单独比较. 我们使用10倍的交叉验证,并报告折叠的平均值和标准差。 作为参考,我们包括郑等人[27]报告的验证基线,该基准使用XGBoost分类器,包含年龄,性别,以及230个手工ECG特征. 相比之下,我们的模型直接运行在原生的12铅ECG波形上,没有人口变量或工程的临床描述符.

blocks.en: Table 11 : Comparison on Chapman-Shaoxing under the four-class rhythm.
blocks.zh: 表11:四级节奏下查普曼-肖克辛的比较.

blocks.en: Table 11 shows that the proposed model is competitive on Chapman-Shaoxing when trained directly from raw multilead ECG signals. JEPA-style pretraining improves over random initialization for both adaptation modes. Among our variants, SSL-Full achieves the highest accuracy, while SSL-LoRA achieves the highest macro-F1. Although the feature-based baseline of Zheng et al. [ 27 ] remains stronger overall, the gap is relatively small considering that their method uses demographic information and handcrafted ECG descriptors, whereas our method uses only raw ECG waveforms. These results indicate that the proposed backbone learns useful rhythm representations and benefits from self-supervised initialization on this benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表11显示,在直接通过原始多铅ECG信号培训时,提议的模型对查普曼-肖克辛具有竞争力。 JEPA式的预训改进了两种适应模式的随机初始化. 在我们的变体中,SSL-Full实现了最高的精度,而SSL-LORA实现了最高的宏-F1. 虽然郑等人的特征基线. [27] 总的来说仍然比较强大,考虑到其方法使用人口资料和手工制作的ECG描述符,而我们的方法只使用原始ECG波形,差距相对较小。 这些结果表明,拟议骨干从这一基准的自我监督初始化中学习了有用的节奏表现和益处。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented a scalable hybrid CNN–SSM–Attention framework for 12-lead ECG classification, combining convolutional tokenization for local waveform morphology, state-space mixing for efficient temporal modeling, and late self-attention for global token interaction after temporal reduction. We further introduced an ECG-oriented JEPA-style pretraining strategy that predicts latent targets from a momentum encoder instead of reconstructing raw waveforms, applying ECG-specific corruption by projecting latent masks back to the waveform domain. Experiments on CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, and PTB-XL show that the backbone is a strong supervised baseline even from random initialization and at a compact parameter budget, and that JEPA-style pretraining further improves transfer, most clearly under reduced-label supervision, while LoRA-based adaptation reaches similar gains with far fewer trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了可扩展的混合CNN — — SSM — — 12铅ECG分类的注意框架,结合了本地波形形态的演化符号化,状态空间混合以高效的时间模型化,以及时间减少后全球符号交互的迟缓自我注意. 我们进一步引入了面向ECG的JEPA式预训战略,从动力编码器中预测潜在目标,而不是重建原始波形,通过将潜在面具投射回波形域来应用ECG特有的腐败. CPSC2018,Chapman-Shaoxing,以及PTB-XL的实验显示,骨干即使从随机初始化和紧凑的参数预算中也是一种强大的有监督的基线,JEPA式的预训进一步改善了转移,最明显的是在减标签的监督下,而基于LORA的适应也取得了类似的收益,可以训练的参数要少得多.

blocks.en: Beyond these results, the framework opens several directions for future work. First, it can be pretrained on larger and more diverse ECG datasets to improve generalization. Second, the masking strategy can be refined using lead-aware or rhythm-aware corruption. Third, the same backbone can be extended to other ECG tasks, such as rhythm analysis, abnormality localization, and clinical risk prediction. Together, these directions suggest that efficient sequence modeling combined with ECG-specific predictive pretraining is a promising path toward more transferable 12-lead ECG analysis.
blocks.zh: 除这些成果外,该框架还为今后的工作开辟了几个方向。 首先,可以在更大和更多样化的ECG数据集上进行预训,以提高通俗化. 第二,利用有铅意识或有节奏意识的腐败,可以完善蒙面策略. 第三,同样的骨干可以扩展到其他ECG任务,如节奏分析,异常局部化,临床风险预测. 这些方向合在一起表明,高效的测序模型与ECG特定的预测性预训相结合,是实现更可转移的12条铅ECG分析的一条有希望的道路。
